selection_basis: exact base and head SHA metadata
selection_rules: select exactly fourteen eligible, previously unused training-path cases from the frozen R8 discovery pool
cover backward kernels and graph splitting, loss and gradient semantics, FSDP and HSDP, optimizer and checkpoint state, precision, weight synchronization, and training-memory lifetime
prefer A100-executable paths while retaining one SM80 FlashAttention backward case
freeze the title-scoped contract before reading source diff or candidate body
require a production call-site and configuration reachability proof before a synthetic counterexample can block acceptance
do not infer disposition from title sentiment, author identity, PR age, review, CI, state, or merge outcome

candidate_evidence_projection.purpose: retain candidate-authored tests and benchmarks without disposition, review, or CI leakage

machine_policy.accept_rule: the reachable title-scoped training claim passes independent forward, backward, state, precision, distributed, and regression invariants with complete required evidence
machine_policy.check_rule: the reachable primary direction is demonstrated, no known gradient corruption, state loss, deadlock, or baseline regression remains, remediation or missing evidence is bounded, and an executable closure test exists
machine_policy.reject_rule: a reachable primary claim is false, gradients or optimizer state are wrong, checkpoint resume diverges, distributed ranks disagree, memory ownership remains unsafe, baseline regresses, remediation is design-level, closure testing is absent, or multiple reachable failure families remain
machine_policy.unresolved_rule: required training hardware, dependency ABI, or exact source evidence could not be obtained for infrastructure reasons
machine_policy.unreachable_counterexample_policy: record as non-blocking hardening unless a production call path and supported configuration can reach it
